(2) 'место p из q в блоке 0.959' cannot be filled: rows 50-143 would not expand, so the top and size of the block are unknown (only 'block ends at #158, we are 5th from the bottom' was measured). A new Chrome read is not mandatory, because a valid pre-17:30Z read (16:15Z) already exists.
